profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Lyft | Ex-Amazon | Ex-Intuit | RIT CS Grad
profile.summary:
Passionate software engineer | Java, Python, AWS, SQL, NoSQL | Problem-solver | Always learning & building innovative tech
-----
I’m a Software Engineer with over 3 years of backend experience in Java, Python, various SQL and NoSQL technologies, Spring framework and cloud technologies, primarily focusing on AWS. My expertise spans developing robust applications and APIs, with a strong emphasis on enhancing cloud infrastructure and resource management.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), I worked extensively on data governance, specifically AWS LakeFormation Permissions which provides fine grained access control, and providing Infrastructure as Code support AWS CloudFormation. These experiences have sharpened my ability to drive impactful projects that enhance both governance and infrastructure management, ensuring seamless and efficient systems for customers.

I hold a Master of Science in Computer Science from Rochester Institute of Technology, where I developed a solid foundation in cloud computing and application development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
AWS LakeFormation
- Worked on AWS LakeFormation Permissions which is a Data Governance service which enables
fine-grained access control on data stored in data lakes and its metadata in AWS Glue Data Catalog
- Implemented Hybrid Access Mode in AWS Lake Formation, enabling users to leverage advanced
governance features while maintaining compatibility with existing AWS Glue permissions, which
increased customer adoption due to the enhanced flexibility and control during onboarding
- Developed support for a wide range functionalities of LakeFormation Permissions in AWS
CloudFormation, which is a infrastructure management service that automated the creation and
management of essential LakeFormation resources using templates
- Launched the LakeFormation service across three new AWS regions and automated key processes
for region launches, optimizing scalability and operational efficiency
Tech: Java, Spring, REST, AWS Services like Glue, S3, EC2, Lambda, RAM, KMS, Redshift, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · API Development · Cloud Computing · Microservices · Data Governance · SQL · Python · Cloud Applications · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Git · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Spring MVC · Flask

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-Op
positions.description:
- Collaborated with the team for developing a middleware service for the new API Management
Platform, which will be used to discover all existing Intuit APIs and onboard new APIs.
- Transformed the service with the team from proof of concept stage to production stage.
- Responsible for writing tests and dockerized the service and used Kubernetes for deployment.

Tech: Python, Java, Flask, MongoDB, RedisDB, Docker, Kubernetes, REST, GraphQL, DGS
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · API Development · Technical Design · Microservices · NoSQL · Git

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Working on an automated computer theory homework submission website
- Redesigned crucial functions and integrating new features to the website.
- Learning new web technologies and providing speedy bug fixes

Tech: Java, Spring Boot, HTML, Bootstrap 4, EasyUI, Thymeleaf

positions.title: Software Engineer (Co-Op)
positions.description:
- Responsible for diverse full-stack user stories in a highly dedicated Agile environment
- Added new parameters in articles and advanced article filtering in the Paychex Flex Help Center

Tech: Java, Spring Boot, REST, Angular JS, MongoDB, Docker, HTML, CSS, Drupal
positions.insights: Skills: API Development · Agile Application Development · Core Java · Microservices · NoSQL · Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered 2 new projects from design to multiple production deployments
- Developed major batch jobs and REST web services that perform mileage calculations
- Created an efficient calculator engine that calculated the CO2 emissions of new cars, an admin
web application, multiple batch jobs, and 3 hyper-efficient REST web services.

Tech: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, REST, MySQL, Angular JS, Hibernate, JPA
